metodo: Pendientes de Theil–Sen por década; veredicto del contrato 1.0.0 (tendencia.py: tres intervalos del 95 %) y veredicto robusto (tendencia_robusta: además Mann–Kendall modificado). diferencia.media = externa − nuestra en los años comunes; r de Pearson anual.

contrastes.frase_en: Fragile warming signal in AIRS3STM 7.0 surface air temperature over Nicaragua (2003–2024, GES DISC OPeNDAP): annual Theil–Sen +0.13 °C/decade ('trend detected', MK p = 0.0095), whereas monthly OLS is not significant (+0.14 °C/decade, p = 0.073) and the monthly Theil–Sen 95% CI spans -0.01 to +0.25 °C/decade. Matches GISTEMP in sign and interannual variability (r = 0.92) at roughly one-third its rate (+0.13 vs +0.38 °C/decade; GISTEMP magnitude is not supported); NASA POWER MERRA-2 gives +0.22 °C/decade ('insufficient evidence', r = 0.82). Caveat: long-term AIRS instrument stability, orbit drift, and cloudy retrieval sampling.
